description: This file contains the server-side logic for an online multiple-choice question (MCQ) exam page within an ASP.NET WebForms application. It manages question retrieval from a SQL database, handles user interactions such as submitting answers, timing the exam, and navigation.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam.aspx page handling quiz logic, database interactions, and user interface updates.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the quiz questions on page load by fetching data from the database based on the selected course and question number.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates the user to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Evaluates the user's answers, calculates the score, saves it to the database, and navigates to the results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles the exam timer; updates remaining time display or ends the exam when time expires.
